services.name: JetSki Tours
services.desc: Thank you or visiting our site and contemplating our tours! Our rates listed are per jetski, regardless if its 1 or 2 passengers. We don’t charge passenger fees. However there is a 400 pound weight limit for your safety. Combined weight may NOT exceed 400 pounds. State law requires a person to be at least 18 years old to rent, 14 years old to operate, and passengers can be any age. Those born on or after Jan. 1st, 1988 may require a Florida Boating Permit to drive. HECTORS TOURS OF MIAMI BEACH, INC DBA AS JET SKI TOURS KEY LARGO. IS A STATE CONTRACTOR FOR THE BOATING EDUCATION TEMPORARY CERTIFICATION AND CAN FACILITATE THE EXAM FOR $9.99 US. One of the most fun parts of Jetski Tours Key

quotes.text: As a concierge in Miami Beach, I have used Hector’s services with Hector’s Water Sports for nearly two decades. What sets Hector apart from his competitors for me is his ability to appeal to all types of people. He can interact with guests whose expectations are geared to a more luxury experience, and for a family a family who want a more causal, relaxed experience His Jet Ski’s are well maintained, and the tour he provides is fun and informative. I heartily suggest you give Hector a try when you want to Jet Ski in beautiful Biscayne Bay.

I have known Mr. Herrera for the last 10 years, during that time, his company of Jet Skis has been my #1 recommendation to all my guests and members at the Trump National Doral (formerly the Doral Golf Resort).Hector has always been a true professional in his field and I have always received nothing but praise about his safe and exciting Jet Ski Tours around the Miami Bay area.As he stated on his promotion “Often copied, never duplicated”. I concur!

This letter is to attest I know Hector, owner of Hector’s Water Sports since 2003.I have been referring and making reservations of Jet Skis to our guests for the last 13 years and Hector brings the ultimate water experience.At the St. Regis Bal Harbour Resort , our discerning guests expect the best quality products and of course the best service and when it comes to water sports, Hector is the Jet Ski business sour concierge team relies on.
